headline: Yoga and Pilates studio at 140 Worcester-Providence Turnpike approved with conditions
summary: The applicant, Tracy Agyei of Her Zen Studio, plans two to three classes a day of about 45 minutes, with hours from 5:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m., Monday through Saturday. Neighbors on Marble Road said cars cut through the rear of the lot and drive too fast, and the conditions require business access from 146, not Marble Road. The board also continued a frontage variance for 10 Burbank Road to December 3rd at 7:00 p.m., to get advice from town counsel.
decisions: Continued the frontage variance request for 10 Burbank Road to December 3rd at 7:00 p.m., 5-0.
Approved 5-0 the special permit for a yoga/Pilates studio at 140 Worcester-Providence Turnpike, with conditions.
discussion: Marble Road traffic: Neighbors said customers cut through the rear of the lot and drive too fast on Marble Road. Members discussed a gate, barrier, or chain that emergency vehicles could still open, and the new owner agreed to talk with the town and tenants.

Burbank Road variance: Members questioned whether the board can grant a variance for a lot that does not yet exist. They also raised self-created hardship, suggested a private road or a planning board route, and said they would seek advice from counsel.

Yoga studio conditions: Members discussed hours from 5:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m., Monday through Saturday, and business access from 146 only. They said the conditions apply to this business, not the other tenants of the building.
